resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO
resources.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT code capable of geometry relaxation, NEB and vibrational analysis. Used as the drop-in replacement for VASP.

resources.name: SSSP PBE pseudopotentials (efficiency)
resources.notes: PAW pseudopotentials for Cu, O and N required by the PBE functional. The efficiency set is recommended.

resources.name: CuO crystal structure (Forsyth & Hull, 1991)

access.notes: Monoclinic CuO, space group C2/c1, a=4.690 Å, b=3.420 Å, c=5.131 Å, β=99.540°. Atomic positions are available from this reference or from public crystallographic databases (e.g. COD entry 1000064).

resources.notes: Experimental bulk structure used to build the CuO(110) slab.
